bundle.shortDescription: Coordinate many coding-agent CLIs from one desktop office.
bundle.longDescription: Agent Office is a desktop crew-office that spawns, routes, and supervises many coding-agent CLIs (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok, Hermes, Qwen, Crush, and others) with a shared Hive message bus, task board, and mission scheduler.
